title: Implement safe staging and discard actions
description: Allow users to stage/unstage supported changes and discard changes only through explicit, safe controls.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can stage and unstage supported files; hunk-level operations are included only if the chosen Git engine supports them reliably.
The UI distinguishes index state from working-tree state and refreshes both after each operation.
Discard actions identify affected paths and require clear confirmation; failure leaves accurate state.
Tests verify operation results and ensure one action cannot silently discard unrelated changes.

steps.details: Native Git supports reliable file-level add/reset/restore/clean operations; hunk operations remain unavailable and are documented.
Added separate typed server operations, API client calls, and 2D controls.
Exact discard confirmations, stale-path rejection, path-scoped commands, unrelated-change preservation, and error refresh are covered.

technicalNotes: Never discard data as a side effect of switching views or branches.
